summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated August 4, 2026, providing a routine weekly progress update on its existing €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on April 30, 2026. During the week ended July 31, 2026, ING repurchased 740,000 shares at an average price of €29.58 for a total of €21,891,581. Cumulative repurchases under the programme were 17,765,193 shares at an average price of €26.65 for €473,449,284.83, completing approximately 47.34% of the programme's maximum value. This is a routine capital-return operational update, not a new special situation event.
